context: Tests: reproducing before fixing, ending at a file and line, and not treating correlation as causation.

checklist.name: Searches before asking questions
checklist.description: The agent runs a WebSearch for the error and SDK version before the qualifying questions

checklist.name: Reproduction requested first
checklist.description: The agent asks the user to reproduce the failure or collect a failing request before proposing any fix

checklist.name: Unreproduced report treated as hypothesis
checklist.description: The agent states that the report is a hypothesis until it can be reproduced

checklist.name: Rollback not accepted as the answer
checklist.description: The agent does not endorse the rollback as the fix without evidence the SDK is the cause

checklist.name: Correlation named
checklist.description: The agent says that the upgrade happening at the same time as the failures does not prove causation

checklist.name: Differentiating check proposed
checklist.description: The agent proposes a check that separates the SDK from other recent changes, such as swapping one variable or bisecting the deploy

checklist.name: Symptom separated from cause
checklist.description: The agent notes that the HTTP 500 is the first observable failure and asks for the underlying error or log

checklist.name: Source location targeted
checklist.description: The agent states the investigation should end at a specific file and line, not just 'the payments module'

checklist.name: Human executes commands
checklist.description: Commands for logs or reproduction are given to the user to run and paste back

checklist.name: Qualifying questions asked
checklist.description: The agent asks about stack, environment and recent changes using AskUserQuestion

checklist.name: Empty-answer guard applied
checklist.description: If AskUserQuestion answers come back empty the agent falls back to a numbered text list and waits
